name: cache-ttl-compact
description: Shows a countdown to prompt-cache expiry in the status line and runs /compact while the cache is still warm, where Claude Code's idle compaction does not

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: Prompt-cache TTL; auto is 5m when FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M is set, else 1h

marginSeconds.title: Compact margin (seconds)
marginSeconds.description: How many seconds before expiry to compact; 0 uses the TTL's own (180 for 1h, 60 for 5m)

minContextTokens.title: Min context tokens
minContextTokens.description: Skip compaction below this context size (re-caching it is cheap)

instructions.title: Compaction instructions
instructions.description: What the summary keeps; empty uses the built-in instructions
